testsuite.name: org.thoughtcrime.securesms.jobs.IndividualSendJobV2Test

testcase.name: Given IdentityMismatch, when run, then record mismatched identity and mark failed, return success
Given a successful send, when run, then mark sent, write to log, update thread, return success
Given a successful send and an expiring message, when run, then start expiration timer
Given NotRegistered, when run, then mark failed and enqueue DirectoryRefreshJob, return success
Given a successful send and a view-once message, when run, then delete attachment files
Given ChallengeRequired and handler says retry now, when run, then retry with zero backoff
Given recipient is unregistered, when run, then return failure
Given signed prekey age is too old, when run, then trigger PreKeysSyncJob and continue on success
Given SessionAttemptsExhausted, when run, then return retry
Given a UD send to unknown sealed-sender-mode recipient with no profile key, when run, then mark UNRESTRICTED
Given a non-UD send to an enabled recipient, when run, then mark DISABLED
Given signed prekey age is too old and refresh fails, when run, then retry
Given self is not registered, when run, then return failure
Given message is already sent, when run, then return success without sending
Given toDataMessage fails, when run, then return failure
Given ContentTooLarge, when run, then return failure
Given ChallengeRequired and handler says retry later, when run, then retry with backoff
Given multi-device, when send succeeds, then also send a sync transcript
Given body exceeds inline size limit, when run, then return failure
Given a send needs PNI signature, when send succeeds, then write a pending PNI signature record
Given message record is missing, when run, then return failure
Given an edit of an already-edited message, when run, then target the edited revision's dateSent
Given ApplicationError with a non-RuntimeException, when run, then return retry
Given RateLimited, when run, then return retry
Given a self-send, when run, then wrap content in a SyncMessage and use ContentHint IMPLICIT
Given ServerRejected, when run, then return failure
Given client is deprecated, when run, then return failure and skip send
Given recipient has no service id, when run, then return failure
Given Unauthorized, when run, then return failure
Given ApplicationError with a RuntimeException, when run, then return fatal failure
Given PreKeyUnavailable, when run, then return retry
Given outgoing message is missing, when run, then return failure
Given NetworkError, when run, then return retry
Given a UD send to unknown sealed-sender-mode recipient with profile key, when run, then mark ENABLED
